description.value: ChongQing is a long-established Szechuan-style Chinese restaurant in Surrey, BC, with over twenty years of operation focused on authentic spicy and flavourful dishes. The restaurant offers both dine-in and takeout, with featured items including Honey Garlic Sliced Pork and Noodle Soup with Mixed Meat & Seafood. It sits in a strip-mall plaza on 120th Street (Scott Road), a major arterial route through South Surrey and Delta.
